name: shot
description: Headless macOS screenshots for agents: capture, mark up, redact, record and find screenshots without taking focus. Bundles the shot MCP server, a skill, /shot and a history pane.

auto_open.title: Auto-open screenshots
auto_open.description: Open shot's output in Preview: off (agent-only), composed (edited images), or all (every capture too)

binary.title: shot binary
binary.description: Path to a shot executable for the /shot command and history pane. Leave empty to use the plugin's own launcher. (The MCP server always uses the launcher; set SHOT_BIN in your environment to point it elsewhere.)
